## What was built

**`js/physiology.js`** — the science layer
- Daniels VDOT from any race time (oxygen-cost / fraction-of-max model), with inverse vVO₂max solving → E/M/T/I/R pace zones; equivalent 5K→marathon performances in the VDOT card
- Coggan 7-zone power (W and %FTP, auto W/kg), Friel 5-zone HR from LTHR, CSS-based 4-zone swim paces
- Exact stress math: bike TSS = hr·IF²·100, rTSS vs threshold speed, sTSS = IF³·hr·100, strength RPE estimate
- Banister PMC: `CTL += (TSS−CTL)/42`, `ATL += (TSS−ATL)/7`, `TSB = CTL−ATL`

**`js/planner.js`** — periodization + adaptation engine
- 22-workout template library (sweet spot, threshold, VO₂, long rides/runs, CSS sets, bricks, foundational strength) with warm-up/work/recovery/cool-down blocks auto-scaled to each session's TSS target
- Mesocycle layout (Base→Build→Peak→Taper, 3:1 recovery) anchored to *distance from race*, so mid-plan regenerations never lose the taper
- Weekly CTL ramp capped at ≤5/week; taper volume solved by bisection on the **real session distribution** to land race-morning TSB at +8 — verified: 8.0–9.4 across all four disciplines, 4/8/16/20-week plans, and post-illness/availability re-plans
- Adaptation events: skipped / shortened (×0.6) / over-reached (×1.25) sessions, illness blocks, availability overrides — remaining plan rebuilt from actual current CTL/ATL with the ramp cap re-applied

**`js/charts.js`** — hand-rolled SVG: PMC with CTL/ATL/TSB lines, daily TSS bars, freshness/overreach risk bands, today + race markers, ghosted original-plan overlay, hover crosshair tooltip; interval block profiles with exact watt/pace targets; TSB form gauge

**`js/export.js`** — per-session or full-plan `.ics` calendar export (95 events for the default plan) and Zwift `.zwo` generation (`Warmup`/`SteadyState`/`IntervalsT`/`Cooldown`, XML-validated, pace-note variant for runs)

**`index.html` / `styles.css` / `app.js`** — dark flagship-studio UI: discipline tabs, profile sidebar with live zone tables, KPI cards + form gauge, week-by-week calendar with phase badges and status styling, workout modal with profile chart, segment table and one-click mark-as controls.

Every engine claim was tested headlessly in Node: VDOT 51.9 for a 40:00 10K → 4:00/km threshold, EWMA constants exact, ramp cap never breached, taper solver converging on target form.
